$comment: Where each piece of static Unbound game data comes from and how far it has been verified. Player/run data never goes here. Checked by test/data/unbound-contract.test.mjs.

routes.description: Route order, per-location encounter species lists and boss placement
routes.source: Inherited from upstream nuzlocke.app (domtronn/nuzlocke.app); original source not recorded
routes.notes: Route order and boss placement inherited. Route names are tracker record keys - see test/data/unbound-route-keys.json. The encounter species lists of the 55 documented main-story routes are maintained by tools/build-unbound-encounters.mjs (see encounters): documented species first, grouped by method, then species only the older list had, kept as an unverified fallback (species the wiki lists only post-game were dropped from those lists). Starter and post-game routes keep the inherited lists.

encounters.description: Main-story encounter species per existing route key (routes.json lists) and their details (method, level range, day/night rate, area, gift/trade/egg/static/special conditions, swarm species), shown in the route encounter picker

sources.name: Pokémon Unbound Wiki (per-location pages)
sources.revision: per location: revid in the data file

encounters.generator: tools/build-unbound-encounters.mjs (raw page cache not committed; rebuild from the recorded revids)
encounters.gameVersion: 2.1.x (wiki pages do not name a version)

secondSource.name: Pokemon Unbound Pokedex (fan site) location pages
secondSource.result: Wild species found by both: Route 2 21/22, Dehara City 9/9, Great Desert 8/8, Ruins of Void 20/20, Fallshore City 10/10, Cootes Bog 12/16, Victory Road 26/35 (the rest are in its post-game area). Antisis City: the wiki page has no wild table while the second source and the legacy list agree on 10 water species - a gap in the wiki. The second source lists species only (no methods, levels or rates), may not be independent of the wiki, and its Route 1 page is clearly wrong (97 species).

validation.inGame: Met species and levels in the player’s local save fixtures fall inside the documented level ranges at the matched locations (test/unbound/locations.test.mjs, skipped without fixtures).

encounters.notes: Post-game sections and rows marked post-game are excluded (V1 = main story). Five wiki species-name typos are corrected in the generator; one impossible level range (Magnolia Fields Pelipper 45-40) is kept unknown. Safari Zone rows have no documented rate and one Noctowl night rate is X% on the wiki: both stay unknown. Only forms the wiki names are recorded. Rates are per-method percentages as given by the wiki.

locations.description: Save met-location id -> existing route key
locations.source: In-game evidence: player save fixtures (local, not committed); each id matched to exactly one location of the documented encounter tables by species line and met level
locations.notes: No documented id table was found (wiki, Unbound-Cloud, PUSE, PKHeX forks). Ids are not FireRed numbering (99 = Route 4). 15 ids mapped; all others show as Unknown location. Mark an entry confirmed only after checking the in-game summary screen.

bosses.description: Gym leaders, rivals (starter variants), Elite Four, Champion, Ruin/Shadow admins, Successor Maxima - Normal and Expert
bosses.source: Inherited from upstream nuzlocke.app; cards cite https://www.pokecommunity.com/showthread.php?t=382178 only
bosses.notes: static/api/league files are generated from league.json (forms dropped from names); the contract test checks they match.

patches.description: Unbound-specific moves (Hidden Power types, Leech Fang, Metal Bash) and abilities (Portal Power, Royal Roar, Cotton Cloud, Bellow)
patches.source: Inherited from upstream nuzlocke.app; original source not recorded
patches.notes: Species, item and fakemon patches are empty: the tracker uses unmodified base species data.

levelCaps.description: Capped Exp. Share level caps for Difficult and higher (used for both Normal and Expert runs)

sources.name: PokeCoders - Level Caps in Pokemon Unbound Explained

levelCaps.notes: Both sources give identical values for 0-8 badges and the post-Tarmigan cap (45); the wiki says caps are removed at Champion. PokeCoders names the milestone 'Tarmigan Mountain', the wiki 'Tarmigan Mansion' (routes.json places Successor Maxima at 'Tramigan Mansion'; not yet confirmed to be the trigger). The sources may not be independent. No documented save flag for the milestone, so the app shows both values at 4 badges. Replaces PUSE's unsourced tables; PUSE's 'normal' table matched except for the missing milestone, and its 'expert' table contradicted both sources.

speciesNames.description: Save species ids -> names/forms, save layout
speciesNames.notes: PUSE's levelCap.js / unboundLevelCaps data are no longer used (see levelCaps).
